verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair ask for a GPU cloud platform's console, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a `vastai` agent skill that lets external AI coding assistants operate the account. That is an integration for third-party agents, not an assistant built into Vast.ai, so it earns no credit. Nothing in the pack documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
